title: 第21章 怒破剑修功法同源第22章 水仙子苏宛
content_zh:
“丙字十九号台，狐歌，对，令狐葱！”
执事长老声落，狐歌身形微动，已如一片落叶般轻飘飘落在擂台之上。
他气息平稳，面容古井无波。
令狐葱是新晋弟子中公认的剑道天才，年纪轻轻便已炼气九层修为！
一手家传的《流光分影剑诀》已得其中三昧，攻击力极强，是本次大比夺冠的热门人选！
他身姿挺拔、面容冷峻，背负一柄古朴长剑。
人如其名，带着一股孤高锋锐之气，眼神锐利如剑，直视狐歌。
“剑修，令狐葱！”
“在下，狐歌！”
“藏头露尾之辈，连自己所修都不敢说出来！”
“只会耍一些诡异手段，看我让你原形毕露！”
剑修之道，一往无前，唯信手中之剑！
他没有任何废话，“叮”的一声清脆剑鸣，背后长剑已然出鞘，化作一道森寒流光落入手中。
剑身震颤，发出嗡嗡轻鸣，凌厉的剑意瞬间锁定狐歌。
空气中有无数细小的剑气在生成。
“流光分影！”
令狐葱低喝一声，身形晃动，手中长剑骤然爆发出刺目灵光。
一剑刺出，在空中分化出三道凝实无比的剑影，直取狐歌上、中、下三路！
剑势极快，剑气撕裂空气，发出尖锐的呼啸！
狐歌屏气凝神，他双手在身前虚抱，一股黑白两色的气流骤然浮现。

一个微缩的旋涡在其掌间流转。
那黑白两色最终化为一道灰色的秽炁，秽炁出现的一刻周围浮现密密麻麻的灰色灵气。
在灰色灵气的侵袭下，那三道剑影慢慢腐朽，直至消散。
“先天秽炁的气息？”
茅不易猛地睁开复眼，感受着狐歌手中的气息。
那气息与他那一道秽炁同宗同源，除了气息稍弱外可以说是完全一样。
“狐歌！”
狐歌被茅不易一叫，瞬间分了神，一道剑气擦着他的肩膀而过。
一道血淋淋的伤口出现在他的肩膀上，伤口若再深几分，怕不是整条胳膊都会被切断。
令狐葱脚踏长剑，目光凌厉，缓缓朝着狐歌飞来。
待着到其身前之时，他缓缓摇了摇头，少年老成的说道：
“狐歌师弟，看来你那混沌灵根也不过如此，不学正统道法，靠歪门邪道注定走不远的。”
“闭嘴！”
狐歌捂着自己的肩膀怒呵道，不知道这句话是说给茅不易的还是令狐葱的。
content_en:
"No. 19, Channel C, Fox Song, yes, Linghu Cong!"
The elder deacon's voice fell, and Hu Ge's figure moved slightly, and fell on the ring as lightly as a fallen leaf.
His breath was calm and his face remained calm.
Linghu Cong is recognized as a swordsman genius among the new disciples. He has reached the ninth level of Qi refining at a young age!
The "Flowing Light Splitting Shadow Sword Technique" passed down from the family has been mastered, and its attack power is extremely strong. It is a popular candidate to win the championship in this competition!
He has a tall and straight posture, a stern face, and carries a simple long sword on his back.
As his name suggests, he has an aloof and sharp aura, and his eyes are as sharp as a sword, looking directly at Hu Ge.
"Sword cultivator, Linghu Cong!"
"I'm here, Fox Song!"
"Those who hide their heads and show their tails don't even dare to say what they have cultivated!"
"You only do some weird tricks, let me show you your true colors!"
The way to practice swordsmanship is to move forward indomitably and only trust in the sword in your hand!
He didn't say anything nonsense. There was a clear "ding" sound from the sword, and the long sword behind him was already unsheathed and turned into a cold stream of light and fell into his hand.
The sword body trembled and hummed softly, and the sharp sword intent locked onto Hu Ge instantly.
There are countless tiny sword energies being generated in the air.
"Streamer splitting shadow!"
Linghu Cong shouted low, his figure shook, and the sword in his hand suddenly erupted with a dazzling light.
A sword thrust out, creating three extremely solid sword shadows in the air, directly attacking the upper, middle and lower paths of Hu Ge!
The sword was moving extremely fast, and the sword energy tore through the air, making a sharp whistling sound!
Hu Ge held his breath and concentrated. He held his hands in front of him, and a black and white air flow suddenly emerged.
A miniature vortex circulated between his palms.
The black and white colors eventually turned into a streak of gray dirty energy, and dense gray spiritual energy appeared around it the moment the dirty energy appeared.
Under the attack of gray spiritual energy, the three sword shadows slowly decayed until they disappeared.
"Innately foul breath?"
Mao Buyi suddenly opened his compound eyes and felt the breath of the fox singer.
That aura is from the same origin as his filthy Qi, except that the aura is slightly weaker, it can be said to be exactly the same.
"Fox song!"
Hu Ge was instantly distracted by Mao Buyi's shout, and a sword energy brushed past his shoulder.
A bloody wound appeared on his shoulder. If the wound had been deeper, the entire arm might not have been severed.
Linghu Cong stepped on the long sword, with sharp eyes, and slowly flew towards Hu Ge.
When he arrived in front of him, he slowly shook his head and said maturely:
"Junior brother Hu Ge, it seems that your chaotic spiritual roots are nothing more than this. If you don't learn orthodox Taoism and rely on crooked ways, you will not be able to get far."
"Shut up!"
Hu Ge clutched his shoulders and shouted angrily. He didn't know whether this sentence was meant for Mao Buyi or Linghu Cong.
